changelog:
- Modern Home Screen: Converted shortcuts to clean modern squircle tiles without artificial background tinting; removed 'You're protected' banner and trending topics bar for a sleek, minimal start page.
- Ghost Mode & Pulse Cleanup: Refined Ghost Mode with a subtle neutral icon; removed glowing radar dots.
- Fullscreen Live Pulse: Opened as an immersive fullscreen view with customizable location/weather (presets + GPS auto-detect), country selector, live financial tickers, categorized news with images, and sports highlights.
- Categorized Menu: Restructured the three-dot menu with a top navigation bar (Back, Forward, Home, Save, Downloads), prominent Site Shield card, top visible quick tools strip (Wallpaper, Custom filters, Dark Mode, Night Reader, Desktop Site), and categorized settings.
- About & Transparency Page: Comprehensive standalone fokk://about page covering browser engine comparisons, multi-tier defense architecture, search engine philosophy, community fundraising/crypto support, privacy policy, and disclaimers.
